downers-grove: Mariposa Mahjong teaches American mahjong around Downers Grove, with Mahjong 101 and 102 sessions at local cafes and restaurants in the western suburbs. Nearby, Mahjong Mischief and a teacher in Elmhurst run beginner classes and guided play at breweries and bars, and Blue Tiger Mahj Club hosts open play and wine nights in Glen Ellyn. Most events sell tickets in advance, so book ahead. If you are brand new, start with a Mahjong 101 session; it introduces the game from the tiles up.
newnan: South of Atlanta, American mahjong is played at the library and in small local groups. The Newnan Carnegie Library hosts open play, the Peachtree City Library runs its own open play sessions, and Tile & Table Tyrone teaches Mahj 101 classes and guided play. Palmetto Mahj holds meetups in the neighbourhood too. Classes are small and social, and schedules change, so check each listing before you go. If you have never played, the Mahj 101 class is the place to start.
roswell: North of Atlanta, The Tiled Sparrow hosts open play, guided play and Mahjong 101 lessons at breweries and restaurants in Roswell and nearby Milton, following the NMJL card. In Johns Creek, the Mahjong League and a city Mahjong Mondays meetup play open games, and Evenings at the Table in Cumming teaches a Mahjong Foundations series from the tiles through the Charleston. Venues change from week to week, so check the address on each event. If you are new, start with a Mahjong 101 lesson or the Foundations series.
oakland: In the East Bay, JCC East Bay offers American Mah Jongg with lessons and open play that welcome beginners. Over the hills in Danville, Bay Area Mahj runs lessons and open play, the Town of Danville offers an introduction to American mahjong, and Jean Melgar teaches American Mah Jongg. Ask each group which National Mah Jongg League card year it plays and how to sign up, since sessions and rooms change. If you are new, start with an introduction class in Danville or a beginner session at the JCC.
new-orleans: New Orleans has a parlor and a JCC program, and the north shore has a weekly game. Fleur de Mahj, in Metairie, offers beginner and strategy classes, guided play and tournaments under official National Mah Jongg League (NMJL) rules. The New Orleans JCC runs multi-session beginner classes at its Metairie and Uptown locations. Across Lake Pontchartrain, Crescent & Tile Mahjong Co hosts Scramble Nights in Slidell for players who already know the game. If you are new, start with a beginner class at Fleur de Mahj or the JCC.
fresno: In the Fresno and Clovis area, American Mahjong comes from Charleston Society, a community group that holds American Mahjong 101 classes and guided play at wine rooms and wineries around the valley, including Kingsburg. Clovis Mahjong Club also runs a Mahjong 101 session for newcomers. Events carry a ticket price and venues change, so check each listing before you go. If you are new, start with a Charleston Society Mahjong 101 class, then move on to guided play.
